summary: Master transfer pricing and international tax compliance with OECD methods, BEPS documentation, and audit-ready tools. Enroll in this 5-day training.
lede: Related-party pricing is the focus of this training for tax and finance professionals handling cross-border transactions. It develops practical skills in functional analysis, pricing-method selection and benchmarking, while covering documentation, audit readiness and margin monitoring through exercises such as building checklists and risk registers, and reviewing intercompany agreements alongside operational reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with related-party transactions, tax reporting, and cross-border compliance decisions.
audience: Indirect Tax and Transfer Pricing Specialist
prerequisites: You should bring a basic understanding of tax and finance processes, along with a willingness to work through intercompany case examples. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for benchmarking and documentation exercises.
